entities.summary: Natalia Valeryevna Anoikina Russian: Наталья Валерьевна Анойкина; born 13 February 1987), née Natalia Anoikina, is a Russian basketball center. She was part of the Russian team that won the 2011 European Championships. At the club level, her teams placed second at the 2009–10 EuroCup and 2014–15 EuroLeague.
